review_candidates.title: Software Engineering Manager, Traffic
review_candidates.description_excerpt: In this role, you’ll spearhead and scale a Cairo-based engineering team responsible for the high-performance traffic and edge networking infrastructure that anchors Procore’s platform. 8+ years of experience in Software, Systems, or Site Reliability Engineering, including 2+ years of formal people management leading distributed teams.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Use your cloud-native networking expertise, technical leadership, and strategic execution skills to eliminate legacy systems, fortify infrastructure security, and scale high-performing engineering talent. 8+ years of experience in Software, Systems, or Site Reliability Engineering, including 2+ years of formal people management leading distributed teams. Deep technical expertise in backend systems, distributed infrastructure, cloud networking (VPCs, routing, DNS), and Kubernetes/EKS operating at scale. Proficiency in leveraging AI tools and autonomous agents to optimize the software development lifecycle.
